body:
I'll start by reading the contract and exploring the source repositories.

Now let me explore the sources thoroughly in parallel.

Now let me study the carapax and tgbotapi-rs sources.

Now I'll write chapter 14.

The first draft is too long; I'll tighten it to the required byte range and fix a citation typo.

Now chapter 15.

The second chapter needs more depth; I'll expand it with verified details.

Now I'll verify every citation resolves in the pinned clones.

Completed both files with all requested topics, verified citations, and byte ranges:

- `protocols/telegram_bots_guide/14-rust-teloxide.md` — 7,283 bytes; 38 citations across 10 pinned teloxide sources (`3c46b96`). Covers `Bot`/Reqwest transport, `Dispatcher`, dptree chains, filters, typed commands, dialogue FSM, keyboard helpers, polling vs axum webhooks, error handling, graceful shutdown, chat-keyed workers, and a when-to-choose rule. Notes that no actix adapter or separate `Reqwest` requester type exists in this snapshot.
- `protocols/telegram_bots_guide/15-rust-carapax-and-tgbotapi.md` — 6,926 bytes; 42 citations across 10 pinned sources (`5566d29`, `bd553c1`). Covers carapax `App`/handler-observer model, `Context`, `TryFromInput` filtering, `Chain`/decorators, `LongPoll`/`WebhookServer`; tgbotapi-rs `Telegram`, `TelegramRequest`, `requests`, types, and the absence of framework batteries; ends with the framework/thin-wrapper/raw-HTTP decision rule.

Verification run on these two files only: every cited path/line and range resolves in the pinned clones, all cited paths appear in `## Sources`, both have 10 source URLs with correct SHAs, first lines use the required `# NN - Title` form, and no non-ASCII prose is present.
